ctx.x: And, of course, then there was just Kirby and Buster, to try to carry on the band. And it was practically impossible because most of the musicians at that time were not disciplined to play those arrangements. It wound up to be just another little jazz combo. And then, too, I think that those arrangements of Kirby's were never put down on paper in detail.
